description: This file contains shell script functions for managing Google Cloud TPU instances within TensorFlow's CI build environment. Functions include installing the Cloud TPU CLI, creating, and deleting TPU instances with customizable parameters.

methods.name: install_ctpu
methods.description: Installs or upgrades the Cloud TPU CLI tool via pip.

methods.name: ctpu_up
methods.description: Creates and starts a Cloud TPU instance with optional parameters.

methods.name: ctpu_delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Cloud TPU instance using metadata stored in files.
